decisions.title: Root Opens the Worktrees; Workers Do Not Claim
decisions.description: main creates wt-t1 and wt-t2, then Promise.all two workers. That matches two App Worktree chats / two CLI -C sessions. This chapter does not restack s17's claim race, and the model has no create_worktree tool.
decisions.alternatives: Let workers claimNext then create a worktree. That re-teaches s17 and hides that Codex binds cwd at session start.

zh.title: root 先开目录，工人不认领
zh.description: main 建好 wt-t1 和 wt-t2，再 Promise.all 两个工人。这对应两条 App Worktree 对话 / 两次 CLI -C。本章不再叠 s17 的抢活，模型也没有 create_worktree 工具。

decisions.title: Same Path, Two Directories
decisions.description: A worktree is another checkout of the same repo, not another repo. alice and bob both write app.txt; the files sit on disk at once because they are not the same directory. Sandbox (s04) still scopes writes to cwd; this chapter does not restack it.
decisions.alternatives: Copy the whole repo, or run in Cloud containers (s23). Heavier than the local parallel-session problem this chapter is teaching.

zh.title: 同路径，两份目录
zh.description: worktree 是同一仓库的另一份 checkout，不是另一份仓库。alice 和 bob 都写 app.txt；两份文件同时在磁盘上，因为根本不在同一个目录。sandbox（s04）仍然按 cwd 锁写；本章不叠一层。

decisions.title: The Merge Is Teaching; Codex Does Not Auto-Merge
decisions.description: Named branches plus merge --no-ff / merge --abort show the deferred conflict. App default is detached HEAD; the product exit is keep the directory, Create branch, Handoff, or open a PR. Cloud apply is s23.
decisions.alternatives: Stop after the two write_file calls. Isolation would still be true, but the 'conflict was only postponed' beat would be missing.

zh.title: merge 是教学用的；Codex 不会自动并进 main
zh.description: 命名分支加上 merge --no-ff / merge --abort，是为了让推迟的冲突看得见。App 默认 detached HEAD；产品出口是留目录、Create branch、Handoff、开 PR。Cloud apply 是 s23。
